youtube_title: Your Gym Wants You NOT To Come 🏋️ #Shorts
youtube_description:
Gyms make money when you DON'T show up.

One branch of a big US gym chain averaged about 6,500 members, with space for only ~300 people inside (NPR Planet Money, 2014).

Tip: take one month first. Go 4 weeks straight, THEN buy the year.
